description:
This is a simple Flipper Zero app that beeps if a wire is continuous.
# How to use
Test a wire by connecting it to pins 6 and 8. If the wire is continuous, you will see the LED turn green and the flipper will beep.
name: [GPIO] Wire Tester
short_description: Beeps if a wire is continuous
